entries.scenario: Operator chat to signed proposal, approval, Discord post/edit/reaction/thread, REST verification, and cleanup
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT; TavallMC development guild; disposable #dev-chat operation
entries.serviceProvider: Discord API v10 through the Java Discord Manager gateway
entries.action: The browser operator chat called the Java demo route: Java observed TavallMC/#dev-chat, formed and approved a signed send_message proposal, edited the bot-authored message, added a checkmark reaction, created a temporary message thread, and displayed the resulting Discord state.
entries.authoritativeVerification: Discord REST read-back returned message 1548575184225828918 with the edited content, Tavall Bot author, one ✅ reaction, and the temporary thread ID. After recording, the message and thread both returned HTTP 404 and were removed from the development guild.
